subject: Question about the Embedded Firmware Engineer opening in Goleta
body:
This is Justin Mascarenhas. I have an M.S. in Computer Engineering from RIT. We were in touch in July about the Application Engineer role in Rochester, and I should have followed up sooner. I saw the Embedded Firmware Engineer opening in Goleta for motor controller and generator control firmware, and since your desk is aerospace and defense, I thought you would know it.

The required side of that posting is close to what I actually do. I have written bare metal C on ARM microcontrollers, programming GPIO, timers, ADC and I2C at the register level, and I built my own low level I2C driver. I have also done interrupt driven motor work, driving motor channels on PWM with quadrature encoder feedback, and I work with oscilloscopes and logic analyzers.

Are you working this requisition, or is there someone else at Actalent I should speak with?

I would appreciate the opportunity to discuss the role further, if your time allows. I can share my resume if that would be helpful.
hook_used: Her desk is Aerospace and Defense at Actalent, and the Goleta req is aerospace flavoured (DO-178C preferred); plus the existing July Application Engineer conversation
